CustomField.description: Single-use cryptographically random token used to resume this submission via an email link. Generated by the Form_Submission trigger as the first 32 hex chars of Crypto.generateAesKey(128) — not derivable from any visible field. External ID + Unique for O(1) lookup by Form_Submission_Prefill. Cleared on prefill consumption, on form submission, and on scheduled expiration. Should NOT be displayed on any record page layout — treat as system metadata.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Single-use cryptographically random token used to resume this submission via an email link. Generated by the Form_Submission trigger when Internal_Send_Resume_Link__c is stamped; cleared by the Form_Submission_Prefill flow on consumption, by the trigger on form submission, and by the scheduled Form_Submission_Expire_Resume_Tokens flow after the configured expiration window. Should NOT be exposed on any record page layout.
CustomField.label: Unique Token
